summary: 0.28.0 entry is a reference manual, not a changelog line list: 14 Breaking bullets plus 19 Added, 7 Changed, plus an 80-row table. Two problems. (1) Incomplete list: the camelCase-keys Breaking bullet (line 129, ~1000 chars) enumerates renamed keys per command and ends the `ingest sessions` group with 'and so on', so the exact renamed keys (malformed_records, skipped_unchanged, sessions_normalized, runs_written, events_written, rows_skipped, workspace_label, project_key, parent_run_id) are no longer stated anywhere; the old notes listed them. Either list them or, better, state the rule once ('every report, error and --input key is now camelCase: snake_case `foo_bar` becomes `fooBar`; the one non-mechanical rename is `out` -> `output` in the export manifest; `policy.*` keys of `canon context` keep policy.yaml's snake_case') and delete the per-command enumeration; that loses nothing a user must know. (2) Density: drop the reference-grade Added bullets that are not upgrade-relevant: the full new-error-code list (line 163, point to `canon schema --errors --json`), the `meta` and `error` field inventories (lines 144-145), the 41-leaf batch count, `MigrateReport.backupDir`/effects, `code_tree`/`worktree_dirty` record fields can be one line. Keep: Breaking items, renamed/removed error codes, exit changes, the Upgrading steps and tables.
